# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

Podlaz is committed to a professional, respectful, and welcoming collaboration environment. Participation should be free from harassment, discrimination, intimidation, and personal attacks.

## Expected behavior

Contributors and maintainers should:

- discuss technical ideas and disagreements respectfully;
- give actionable, good-faith feedback;
- respect different backgrounds, experience levels, and perspectives;
- take responsibility for mistakes and correct them;
- protect other people's private information.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, threats, discriminatory or demeaning comments, sexualized conduct, deliberate disruption, doxxing, and sustained bad-faith interaction.

## Scope

This code applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, project-managed communication spaces, and situations where someone is representing Podlaz publicly.

## Reporting and enforcement

If you experience or witness a possible violation, report it privately to the maintainer using a private contact method published on the maintainer's GitHub profile. If no private contact method is available, open a minimal repository issue asking for a private contact channel and do not include sensitive details.

Reports will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible. Depending on severity and history, maintainers may remove content, issue warnings, limit participation, temporarily restrict access, or permanently ban participation.

Good-faith reports will not be retaliated against.

## Attribution

This policy is informed by the Contributor Covenant and its community-safety principles:
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/
